business_summary.text: Optiemus Infracom Limited is a diversified manufacturing company with a focus on EMS (Electronics Manufacturing Services), B2C products, and high-tech segments like cover glass and drones. The company is leveraging policy tailwinds like PLI 2.0 and expanding its B2C footprint.

operating_notes.text: AI+ smartphone EMS partnership contributed ~₹500 Cr in Q1FY27
Noida Unit 3 commissioned, adding 6 million units annual capacity

timeline.summary: Optiemus Infracom shifted its credit rating mandate to CRISIL, receiving CRISIL BBB/Stable and A3+ ratings for ₹50 Cr bank facilities, an upgrade from ICRA BBB-/A3.
Optiemus Infracom enhanced its corporate guarantee for subsidiary Optiemus Electronics Limited to ₹55 Cr with Axis Bank.
Optiemus Infracom filed the Q4 FY26 Monitoring Agency Report by ICRA detailing ₹216.86 Cr preferential issue proceeds utilization.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹484.98 Cr (+8.0% YoY), net profit ₹22.47 Cr (+0.0% YoY) (includes ₹13.86 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹8.61 Cr).
Q1FY27 results: Revenue ₹4,486 Cr (+103% YoY), EBITDA ₹413 Cr (+40% YoY), PAT ₹212 Cr (+46% YoY); Noida Unit 3 commissioned
Optiemus Infracom approved an unsecured loan of up to ₹50 Cr to its wholly owned subsidiary GDN Enterprises Private Limited.
